manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: All-Fates Stalker must be exiled by Changeling Berserker, and Yannik must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Yannik for its mana cost.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Changeling Berserker until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, All-Fates Stalker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it exiles Yannik until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of All-Fates Stalker's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Changeling Berserker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Berserker enters, it exiles All-Fates Stalker until Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Berserker's ETB.
When All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
